freeze_scope: Retrospective extension specified before its own outcomes; no external registration or new cohort

perblock.orders: All permutations in canonical uv, raman, nir order
perblock.selection: Greedy forward block-prefix selection using pooled raw-unit inner threefold MSE independently for each target
perblock.preprocessing: Same declared historical SO-PLS options; select complete order and preprocessing path by final-stage inner MSE
perblock.stage_tie: Lowest pooled inner MSE then smaller current k; exact floating-point ties only
perblock.final_tie: Lowest final-stage pooled inner MSE; lower sum(k); lexicographic ordered k vector; canonical block order; declared preprocessing order; path_id
perblock.refit: Refit every complete prefix on each inner fitting partition, including orthogonalization and scaling; final chosen vector refit on the outer training partition
perblock.failure: Any candidate or final fit error aborts the current task and the run; no outer-label fallback and no silent exclusion
perblock.completion: All fifteen tasks and all eleven targets required; retain outcomes in either direction
perblock.score_scope: Inner scores guide selection and are not unbiased performance estimates
perblock.complexity_scope: Per-block allocation plus reduced component ceiling; not a matched-complexity test of raising the old ceiling

multiplicity.primary: Historical PLS, Ridge, RBF-KRR, uniform SO-PLS and new per-block SO-PLS for U+R to U+R+N
multiplicity.secondary: Uniform versus per-block SO-PLS within each of the two fixed masks
multiplicity.scope: Holm within each explicitly declared family; original recorded tables remain unchanged
